# Pass Two — Gevurah Critique: 20 Required Improvements

The Awtsmoos is boundless light; Gevurah makes the vessel clear;
A plan becomes a working world when every hidden edge draws near.

1. Discover every movie-capable route, not only obvious filenames.
2. Search `movie`, `film`, `animation`, `timeline`, canvas, SVG, WebGL, Three.js.
3. Trace imports/call sites before rewriting shared modules.
4. Identify existing JSON/data formats and preserve compatibility where useful.
5. Separate authoring schema from rendering engine state.
6. Normalize all timing into seconds with deterministic duration rules.
7. Define stable IDs for scenes, actors, tracks, and effects.
8. Add capability negotiation for renderer-specific features.
9. Make unsupported features diagnosable rather than silently ignored.
10. Model text as first-class animation content.
11. Model infographic/chart primitives as first-class content.
12. Model characters separately from generic shapes/meshes.
13. Model camera choreography separately from object animation.
14. Provide procedural/particle primitives with seeds.
15. Avoid huge hardcoded showcase files by splitting acts/scenes.
16. Make controls thumb-friendly and responsive first, desktop enhanced second.
17. Ensure stage aspect-ratio adaptation does not distort authored coordinates.
18. Verify long movie duration programmatically and in playback state.
19. Browser-test both 2D and 3D routes at narrow and wide viewports.
20. Re-read all touched files and run a full planned-vs-actual delta review.
